name: Crystal Faction
description: Powerful mages of the northern Crystal Grove. Territorial but valuable allies.

name: Nomad Tribes
description: Wandering survivors of the Dustplains. Hard to find, harder to earn trust from.

name: Lich Faction
description: Servants of the ancient being atop Olympus Mons. They do not welcome outsiders.

name: Traders' Guild
description: Independent merchants who deal with anyone who has credits. Strictly neutral.
